content:
The antonym for "stand out from" is A) "Blend in with."

- "Stand out from" means to be easily noticed or distinct from something.
- "Blend in with" means to not be easily noticed or to be similar to something.

The other options are more similar in meaning to "stand out from":
- B) "Distinguish from" means to recognize or identify as different.
- C) "Emerge from" means to come out from or become apparent.
- D) "Separate from" means to set or keep apart.
